# Sandpack Docs Introduction

Source: `https://sandpack.codesandbox.io/docs`

## Key points

- Sandpack is a component toolkit for live-running code editing experiences.
- It is powered by the CodeSandbox online bundler and broader runtime stack.
- The docs present Sandpack as able to run JavaScript and Node.js apps in the browser.
- The public docs focus more on embedding and UI/tooling than on the internals of the Node runtime itself.

## Why this matters

This page is useful context because it shows how the runtime is positioned inside the broader Sandpack ecosystem. The implementation details for the Node runtime live in the separate `nodebox-runtime` repository.
